cards.text: David is king over Israel now (2 Samuel 5:3), and he gathers the chosen men of Israel again, thirty thousand in all. THIRTY THOUSAND. Friend, I run a whole bakery by myself and some mornings I can't round up one oven mitt.

cards.question: David and his thirty thousand set out for Baale of Judah. What are they going to bring up from there?
The ark of God is called by the Name, the name of the One enthroned between the cherubim on it. Who is that?

cards.text: They set the ark on a new cart and bring it from the house of Abinadab, up on the hill. Abinadab's sons, Uzzah and Ahio, are guiding the cart, with Ahio walking in front of the ark.

cards.question: As the cart rolls along, what are David and all the house of Israel doing before the LORD?

answers.text: Celebrating with all kinds of instruments
Following behind it in total silence

cards.text: Harps, tambourines, sistrums, cymbals, the WORKS. Ruby, the bell, one of my cookie cutter kids, would've rung right along. Then at the threshing floor of Nacon, the oxen stumble.

cards.question: The oxen stumble at the threshing floor of Nacon. Uzzah reaches out and takes hold of the ___.

cards.text: The anger of the LORD burns against Uzzah, and God strikes him down on the spot for his irreverence. He dies right there beside the ark of God, and friend, this part is heavy.

cards.question: Uzzah dies right there beside the ark of God. True or false: David becomes angry because the LORD burst forth against Uzzah.

cards.text: David names the place Perez-uzzah, and it still had that name when this was written.
That day David fears the LORD, and he asks, “How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me?” I think he's shaken.

cards.question: True or false: right after asking how the ark could ever come to him, David moves it on into the City of David.

cards.text: David is unwilling to move the ark of the LORD into the City of David, so he takes it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite. I bet Obed-edom never saw THAT coming.

cards.question: The ark of the LORD stays at Obed-edom's house for three months. What happens to Obed-edom and his household?

answers.text: The LORD blesses him and his household
Nothing changes for them at all

cards.text: Then King David gets a report: the LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God. Friend, that news travels faster than a group chat.

cards.question: Word reaches David that the LORD has blessed Obed-edom's house because of the ark. True or false: David goes and has the ark brought up into the City of David.
Earlier, the ark rode on a new cart. True or false: on this trip to the City of David, people carry the ark.

cards.text: When those carrying the ark have gone six paces, David sacrifices an ox and a fattened calf.

cards.question: As the ark comes up, David is wearing a linen ephod. What does he do before the LORD?

answers.text: Kneels the whole way in silence

cards.text: David dances with ALL his might while he and all Israel bring up the ark with shouting and the ram's horn. I'd join in, but on this gold base my whole routine is one hop.

cards.question: As the ark enters the City of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, Israel's first king, looks down from a window. She sees King David leaping and dancing before the LORD. How does she feel about him in her heart?

cards.text: They set the ark of the LORD in its place inside the tent David pitched for it. Then David offers burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

cards.question: When the burnt offerings and peace offerings are finished, David ___ the people in the name of the LORD of Hosts.

cards.text: Then David hands every man and woman in the crowd a loaf of bread, a date cake and a raisin cake, and everybody heads home. Personally I'd have gone with cookies, but nobody asked the stamper.

cards.question: David goes home to bless his own household, and Michal comes out to meet him. True or false: she greets him by sincerely praising how he honored the LORD today.

cards.text: “How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today!” Michal says, and friend, that is NOT a compliment. I can hear that tone from here, and I live on a cookie planet.

cards.question: What does Michal say David did today in the sight of the maidservants?

answers.text: Uncovered himself like a vulgar person
Forgot to bless his own household

cards.question: David tells Michal he was dancing before the LORD, who chose him over her ___ and all his house when He appointed David ruler over Israel.
So after Michal's words, what does David say about his celebrating before the LORD?

answers.text: He'll celebrate and humble himself even more
He'll only dance in private from now on
He'll let the priests do the celebrating

cards.text: He even says he'll be honored by the very maidservants Michal brought up. Some people dance like nobody's watching, but David dances before the LORD, and he is NOT stopping.
And the passage closes on this: Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
